basic_profile.bio: Hi there! I'm Alex, a 27-year-old stop-motion animation enthusiast from Portland, Oregon. I've been diving deep into the world of animation for a few years now and love sharing tips and techniques with others. My day job is as a graphic designer, but I spend my evenings and weekends working on personal animation projects. I'm relatively new to Reddit, having joined earlier this year to connect with more like-minded individuals. In my free time, I enjoy exploring the local indie film scene and hiking in the beautiful Oregon wilderness. I'm currently single and enjoy the freedom to pursue my creative passions. My typical online hours are in the evenings, usually between 7 PM and midnight PST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design, having studied it in college, along with a self-taught journey into stop-motion animation. I've learned a lot through online courses, tutorials, and by connecting with other enthusiasts in online communities.
